purpose: P2 evidence records only; P1 defines fields and does not populate scientific findings.

sentinel_values.NOT_REPORTED: Source was checked at the relevant location but does not report the field.
sentinel_values.NOT_APPLICABLE: Field does not apply to this source/evidence item.
sentinel_values.NOT_VERIFIED: P2 has not verified this field; never infer a value.
sentinel_values.BLOCKED_IDENTITY: Source identity is not approved; no scientific extraction allowed.

provenance_rules: Never cite M23 content until P0_M23_REMEDIATION is closed.
Do not convert AGENT_INFERENCE into AUTHOR_RESULT.
Use pdf_page as physical page index; record printed_page only when visibly confirmed.
Keep one evidence record focused on one finding or locator.
